notes: T7c synth archetype library for the VCV/PDL pipeline. An archetype is a param-cloud projection onto EXISTING topology — it never injects modules. v0.2 (2026-05-29), shaped by the first Rack audition of the v0.1 patches: (1) a param-cloud value may be a REGION NAME (string → seed-sampled at a deterministic position, the expressive axis) OR a NUMERIC LITERAL (pinned, clamped to the param's range, the identity axis) — so the seed varies what should vary and leaves identity-critical settings fixed; (2) clouds now set MODULATION DEPTH (attenuverter params like VCF.FREQ_CV, VCO.FM_DEPTH), because v0.1 set destination knobs but left depths at zero, making cabled modulation silent — depth values for pluck/warm_pad are calibrated from Loudon's hand-refinements (FREQ_CV ≈0.38 / ≈0.03); (3) each archetype declares RECOMMENDED_CABLES between roles — the emitter WARNS (T12 'make failure loud') when an identity cable is absent, without injecting it, because topology stays a PDL/T6 decision; (4) base oscillator FREQ is pinned to keyboard-tracking (0) for played voices so a static multi-octave offset can't fight the played pitch — drone keeps a FREQ region as the documented unplayed/sustained exception, and sub_bass pins a -12 octave offset as an intentional register choice. Region names reference perceptual regions in vcv_fundamental_registry.json (v2.3+). Resolver: resolveArchetype in PDL Renderer.html. Emit precedence: explicit PDL `*` line > archetype param > registry default. Project data with its own `version`; not palace ontology.

constraints.label: pitch-fall decay matches amp decay (the kick punch)

recommended_cables.label: pitch envelope sweeps VCO pitch via FM — this is the kick's punch; without it FM_DEPTH modulates nothing
LFO breathes the cutoff — the pad's slow evolution; without it FREQ_CV modulates nothing
envelope sweeps the cutoff per note — THE pluck character; reuse the amp envelope into VCF:FREQ. Without it the patch is a static-filter blip, not a pluck
envelope drives the resonant sweep — the 303 squelch; deep FREQ_CV is meaningless without this cable
slow LFO into VCO FM gives the drone its slow detune/movement; FM_DEPTH is silent without it
